messages:
mira: Customer asked for a "multi-lane" tool invocation API today. They want independent retry budgets per lane, ordered processing inside a lane, and fast partials for UX.
ben: Can we get the exact user journey? UI wants first visible result in <250ms while background enrichments continue.
tia: Important: they integrate with unreliable third-party webhooks. They insist on ‘at-least-once’ semantics but also want dedup hints to avoid duplicate side-effects.
sam: From the API POV we should support: lane grouping, lane-level retry_budget and strategy, ordering flags, dedup_token per call, and a streaming channel for partials. Also an explicit termination policy.
mira: They also asked for alternate delivery: stream over connection OR webhooks for long-running lanes.
ben: Ops concern: webhook retries + our retries doubles load. We need clear separation: internal retries vs external callback retry attempts. Add a configurable suppression window for idempotent tool calls.
tia: Proposal for payload shape (conceptual):
- top-level: "lanes": [ { "lane_id": "string", "fail_policy": "continue|abort", "retry_budget": "int", "striped": true|false, "delivery": "stream|webhook" , "invokes": [ {"tool":"id","dedup_key":"str","timeout_ms":int,"retry_strategy":"exp|linear|none"} ] } ]

sam: UX for partials: stream mode emits chunked JSON with meta per chunk: lane_id, invoke_id, status{started|partial|done|failed}, retry_count. Webhook mode posts per-invoke result and a final receipt on lane completion.
mira: For ordered lanes with fail_policy=abort we must define if abort cancels in-flight invokes in other lanes. My view: abort only affects the same lane; other lanes remain unaffected unless request-level fail_fast=true.
ben: Billing note: we need to show customers how retries and callback round-trips will affect token/compute billing. Suggest adding a header X-Estimated-Cost and a post-run cost breakdown endpoint.
tia: Safety: some tools may have side effects. We must require explicit manifest of side-effecting tools and default to retry_strategy=none for those unless dedup_key provided.
sam: SDK work: add high-level helper that calls /v1/parallel-invoke, automates dedup_key generation for idempotency, and exposes progress events. Keep low-level shape for customers who want custom behavior.
ops-bot: Note: create a runbook entry for webhook backoff patterns and rate-limiting propagation.
mira: Launch gating checklist draft:
- API spec and OpenAPI examples (product)
- SDK examples (JS + Python) and streaming client docs (devex)
- Perf matrix: p50/p95 for 1-lane, 2-lane, 5-lane on Dedicated and Hosted (eng)
- Integration test harness with flaky downstream mocks and webhook sinks (sre)
- Billing prototype that returns estimated costs and final breakdown (finance/eng)
- Security signoff for audit trails and dedup tokens on Private (security)
- Pilot agreement and SLO for customer (sales/cs)

ben: For initial MVP let's target ordering guarantees within a lane only, retry budgets applied per lane, streaming partials via chunked responses, webhook delivery as experimental.
tia: Agree. Also include an opt-in header X-Enable-Dedup to make dedup behavior explicit.
sam: Question: what HTTP status do we return when some lanes fail? Return 200 with per-lane statuses and overall state=partial|complete|failed. Streaming mode will keep connection open until all lanes finish or request-level timeout.
mira: Add request-level timeout and a cancel token. Client can send abandon signals and we should stop retries for lanes that are abandoned.
ben: I'll prototype a perf run for 2-lane fanout next week and share numbers.
tia: I'll draft the initial spec doc with examples and safety notes by EOD Friday. Please comment inline.
sam: I'll draft SDK helpers and the streaming interface spec.
ops-bot: Reminder: tag RFC under PROD-para-lanes and schedule 30min sync with customer next week.
mira: Thanks team "
